description: Turn email alert types on or off, or choose right away or one daily summary, for yourself in your workspace. Send preferences, delivery or both, naming at least one alert type; the types are approval requested, dispute opened, webhook failing, payout update and outcomes needed. A caller that gets no alerts is refused. Needs a Last Price credential with notifications write scope; the agent that owns an unclaimed workspace needs none.
